dependency.reuse: exact recommend.__code__; isolated per-call globals replace only _validate; no second numerical planner

candidate: Original A candidate_four_channel_input exact whitelist, including complete observation_identity, source_time, counts, quality and diagnostic_flags. No renaming of original private context boot_id into protocol BOOT.
missing: Explicit null for unavailable Root/config/book ID/admissions/capture association/pose receipt/revision/read/span/call/registry/actions/execution receipt. Empty admissions is missing evidence; explicit empty actions only from actual Root registry. Legal missing tail or insufficient proven coverage is INPUT_UNAVAILABLE, STOP, core_ran=false. Never synthesize fields.

timing.integers: All QPC/revisions uint63 strict int (not bool or float); original absolute QPC retained. No future supplied event, bracket or span.
timing.nominal: Original source_start_monotonic_ns + (source tick - source_start_tick_ms)*1000000. Original source clock never reset.
timing.adc: nominal <= pose_read.begin <= pose_read.end <= adc_call.begin <= adc_call.end <= admission_received. Closed valid_span must cover nominal, full read and full call.
timing.native_em: Native source admission and real ADC==EM nominal required; same original pose/revision. Its own read.end <= original native ADC call.begin. Original span covers nominal, own read, native call.
timing.held_em: Exact original native EM receipt/revision/read/span retained; check original native call only, never later held ADC call. Original native capture must remain available.
timing.current: at_qpc_ns == now; read.end <= now; closed span covers full read and now.
timing.revision: Within full context/generation/book/owner namespace, same revision means same pose. Different revision closed spans cannot overlap; chronologically later spans cannot have smaller revision.
timing.action: state executed only. at_qpc_ns is original Root completion/commit point when to_pose_revision became committed; not dispatch, start, ACK or callback receipt. Unknown completion => missing execution receipt/registry, unavailable.
timing.action_span: For every supplied action (to R, at T), every supplied revision<R span.through<T; revision>=R span.from>=T. No inferred duration. to>from, ordered execution/revisions; current>=latest to and equal revision has equal pose.
timing.causality: Executed action follows actual received original observation; any caused capture nominal ADC follows that executed commit strictly.
timing.age: All supplied admissions use exact original integer received-source age: negative rejects; >100000000 ns records stale. Traverse entire prefix and all independent supplied associations before classifying. Exactly100000000 remains allowed. Capture-time and now-source100ms gates remain. Only private absolute Fraction(qpc_ns,1000000); no reset, rounding or Fraction output.
timing.source_c3: Producer source model ticks and contiguous ten ADC admissions govern C3; initial ticks <90ms cannot have healthy C3. Separate from absolute QPC freshness.

limits.source_prefix: Complete original indices 0..1000; no reset, sliding prefix or interior omission. Missing legal tail unavailable; nonzero start/internal hole rejected. Tick gaps preserve original C3 continuity semantics.
limits.raw_line_exception: Only exact root_receipt/captures/<index>/request_raw or capture_raw. Embedded raw JSON receives ordinary 32-array cap; no nested source_admissions exception.
limits.combined_captures_and_actions_rule: Before any missing/disabled return: max(len(history)+1, len(supplied root.captures or [])) + len(supplied actions or []) <=32. Null means zero supplied items for budgeting only, never evidence. Late association bound remains.

strictness: Exact fields, strict JSON finite types, duplicate keys rejected, hashes and returned raw identity/count/quality words checked. Malformed/reversed/provided identity or revision conflicts/hidden fields/budget breaches raise Rejected, including disabled paths. Every returned output has bounded strict validation.
numerical_policy: Frozen C28: 0.25m pairwise displacement, 15 degree forward-axis support (roll-only retained), 30 degree native EM direction cone, goal-sensitive 3D advice, quality conservative STOP. No new numerical algorithm.
validation_order: strict structure, resource caps, all supplied decidable identity/order/temporal associations
complete fresh => original C28 code object exactly once

partial_evidence_validation.anchor: Actual retained candidate source_start_tick_ms/source_start_monotonic_ns must agree; supplied config must agree. Original source_time is passed explicitly for admission validation, never substituted as config.
partial_evidence_validation.raw: Each supplied raw request/capture is independently checked against candidate/context/hash/values/words. Absolute baseline comparisons and initial trigger progression require actual config; supplied counter internal/cross-capture feasibility is independently checked. Candidate/config trigger remains checked even when capture receipts are missing.
partial_evidence_validation.missing: Required absent evidence is recorded, not an early exception. Continue all rules whose actual operands are present. Well-formed inadequate span coverage is missing evidence. Missing a raw/config/record must not hide a contradiction in another supplied fact.
partial_evidence_validation.held: Compare every supplied native/held identity/read/span/revision fact. Null proof stays missing; never fill it from later/current pose. Native/held provenance and original native call unchanged.
partial_evidence_validation.actions: Check supplied duplicates, state, ordering/revisions and known observation/cause times even if execution receipt or unrelated evidence missing. Missing operands defer only their own dependent comparisons.
partial_evidence_validation.classification: No Rejected catch or blanket exception conversion. Missing reason precedes stale; disabled precedes both only after all decidable consistency checks. Every return retains strict output budget.

counter_feasibility.same_capture: All four lane first/second counters equal, third increases exactly1 per channel; final equals last lane on all three components.
counter_feasibility.nonnegative_baseline: At actual request_seq s, lane0 counters >= [4*s,s,4*(s-1)+1] componentwise; all actual counters remain uint32.
counter_feasibility.cross_capture: Among supplied original raw captures at actual sequence difference d, same-channel deltas are [4*d,d,4*d], including across missing intermediate raw captures.
counter_feasibility.evidence_boundary: Algebraic consistency only. No derived baseline becomes config/identity/output evidence. Real config remains required; supplied config retains exact absolute comparisons.
